thread:
deploy-bot: Deploy job 5781 failed during image promotion. Error: 409 Conflict - immutable tag
sarah: Confirmed, we flipped on immutable tag enforcement last month.
mike: Looks like two promote steps hit `redwood/api:latest` at the same time?
ci-systems: Correct. Job 5779 promoted and finished at 12:04:02, job 5781 hit the promote and got 409 at 12:04:12.
jen: Ugh. Our release job still relies on promoting `latest` which is racy.
ops-oncall: We can't overwrite - repo policy forbids replacing tags.
sarah: Short fix: retag the built image with the commit sha and promote that tag. Longer fix: stop using mutable `latest` during promote.
mike: I'll push `redwood/api:sha-1a2b3c4` and run a manual promote job.
alex: For CI, add a guard: if `COMMIT_SHA` exists use `:sha-${COMMIT_SHORT}` in promote; otherwise fail and surface clearer error.
ci-systems: Manual promote triggered: https://ci.redwood.internal/5782/promote
ci-systems: Promote finished successfully for redwood/api:sha-1a2b3c4
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for sha-1a2b3c4 (traffic=5%)
jen: Smoke tests: `auth-session` and `graphql-int` passing locally.
ops-oncall: Canary metrics look stable after 4m. No error spikes. :thumbsup:
release-manager: Pausing cut until the promoted sha is in the release manifest and health is green. Holding change window til 12:30 UTC.
mike: Updated release manifest and release notes: "Pinned image to redwood/api:sha-1a2b3c4 due to immutable-tag collision; CI promoter updated to prefer sha-tags." PR: https://git.redwood/internal/release-notes/patch/812
sarah: I'll open RFC for promoter leader-election and atomic tag creation flow. cc @eng-infra
alex: I'll add a runbook step for on-call: how to retag+promote and verify canary.
jen: Great work everyone, thanks for quick turnaround. :tada:
